name: deploy_multiview_blcs_v3_simfix_c3_6_v2
command: MPLBACKEND=Agg PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True .venv/bin/python -m src.tasks.blcs.scripts.train --config-name train_chunked data.num_court_kp=14 data.num_views_range=[3,6] data.camera_mode=random data.batch_size=4 data.seq_len_range=[64,256] data.num_workers=2 data.chunk.generation_workers=8 data.chunk.epochs_per_chunk=20 training.position_axis_weights=[1.0,4.0,1.0] training.trainer.max_epochs=200 training.trainer.check_val_every_n_epoch=5 training.qualitative_logging.enabled=false training.early_stopping.enabled=false run.gpus=1
